general.ASAP: as soon as the requirements allow

diplomacy.Puppet+: puppet with resource rights and war reparations
diplomacy.Balkanize+: create as many smaller puppets as possible and take resource rights and war reparations

conventions.up: The next useful level of the technology branch, even on its first mention.
conventions.on_focus: On a focus names its completion; on picking a focus names its selection.
conventions.production_order: Listed production lines indicate priority; from indicates reassignment.
conventions.production_remaining: ALL assigns all remaining and future military factories to this line; keep it last in priority.
conventions.arrow: The meaning of an arrow depends on its domain; do not infer a universal condition.

vocabulary_sources.doctrines: English doctrine names in ABBREVIATIONS & TOOLS, Part III; IDs resolved from installed common/doctrines. Short forms require a Land/Air/Naval Doc qualifier.
vocabulary_sources.political_traits: English trait names and character instances from installed common/characters; no nation-specific aliases.
